<p>Last updated: 26 October 2026</p>

<p>This policy sets out how long Velstrian Systems Ltd retains each category of personal and business data we process. Retention periods balance your right to erasure under UK GDPR Article 17 against our legal obligations (tax, company, and regulatory record keeping) and legitimate operational needs.</p>

## 1. Retention schedule

## 2. Account closure (UK GDPR Article 17)

<p>Closing your account via <strong>Account → Delete account</strong> starts a<strong> 14-day grace period</strong>. The moment you confirm:</p>

<ul><li>your profile is soft-deleted (you are signed out and cannot sign in again)</li><li>all active Stripe subscriptions are cancelled immediately</li><li>a confirmation email is sent with a one-click cancel link</li></ul>

<p>If you do nothing for 14 calendar days, the scheduled hard-delete runs:</p>

<ul><li>your profile row and every user-owned record cascade-deletes</li><li>your Stripe customer is deleted</li><li>your name and email are redacted from audit-log entries (organisation, action and timestamp are preserved anonymously for the compliance trail)</li><li>if you were the sole owner of your organisation, the organisation row is deleted too</li></ul>

<p>Billing records, VAT validation logs and anonymised audit-log entries are retained for the statutory period shown in the schedule above even after closure, but contain no directly identifying personal data after the hard-delete completes.</p>

## 3. Subject Access Requests (UK GDPR Articles 15 + 20)

<p>You can request a portable copy of every record we hold on your account at any time from <strong>Account → Data export</strong>. We process the request asynchronously and email you a private download link to a ZIP archive (one JSON file per data category) usually within a few minutes. The link is single-tenant-signed and expires after<strong> 7 days</strong>; you can request a new export at most<strong> once every 30 days</strong>.</p>

<p>If you prefer a written request, email <a href="mailto:contact@velstrian.com">contact@velstrian.com</a> and we will respond within one calendar month (UK GDPR Article 12(3)).</p>

## 4. Backups

<p>Our hosting provider, Supabase, takes an encrypted backup of the database every day and keeps it for 7 days on our current plan. Deleted data may remain in these backups until the backup itself expires. We do not remove individual rows from backups, in line with UK ICO guidance on backup retention.</p>

## 5. Your other rights

<p>You can request access, correction, deletion, portability, or restriction of your personal data at any time by emailing <a href="mailto:contact@velstrian.com">contact@velstrian.com</a>. We respond within one calendar month (UK GDPR Article 12(3)).</p>

## 6. Changes to this policy

<p>Material changes to retention periods will be announced at least 30 days in advance via in-app banner and email to the registered account-holder address.</p>
